name: Employers
overview: Scripture emphasizes the responsibility of employers to act justly and honorably toward their workers, particularly those who are hired and vulnerable. Employers are commanded not to withhold wages or defraud their servants, recognizing that timely and fair payment is a matter of righteousness (Leviticus 19:13; Jeremiah 22:13). Oppressing the poor or withholding their rightful earnings invites divine judgment, as God Himself stands as a witness against such injustice (Deuteronomy 24:14; Malachi 3:5). Furthermore, the principle that labor deserves its due reward underscores the biblical view that work is not a matter of grace but of debt, reinforcing the obligation to compensate workers fairly (Romans 4:4).
